name: TIC 382303209

text.card: A red giant 1,010 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.23 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,848 K at its surface.
